data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the same order (Gutenberg, then Wikipedia, then a note with the same template), but it lists only book_title as a parameter and treats the author as something found on the page, while the true workflow takes author as an input to pick the right book. It also omits the "do not download" constraint and the tab switching, so an automation could pick the wrong book when titles are ambiguous.
